other_failure_modes.name: Feature engineering leakage before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: Computing statistics such as value counts (frequency encoding) on the concatenated train and test datasets before splitting leaks test set distributions into the training data. This compromises the integrity of the cross-validation process.

summary: The agent provides a solid LightGBM solution with stratified K-fold cross-validation, proper out-of-fold target encoding, and seed averaging. However, the agent introduces critical data leakage by computing frequency encoding on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. Additionally, it relies on a single evaluation metric and a naive unweighted average for its ensembling.
